versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- Version 0.1.1 released with no detected file changes.

firecrawl-mcp 0.1.0

- Initial release of firecrawl-mcp skill.
- Unified API access via OneKey Gateway for web scraping and site mapping tools.
- Supports firecrawl_scrape for structured data, full content, or brand identity extraction from single URLs.
- Supports firecrawl_map to discover and search website URLs, aiding in locating specific content.
- Includes best-practice guidance for format selection and handling JavaScript-heavy pages.
- Requires a OneKey Gateway API key; demo key fallback provided for testing.
